notes: This is the canonical halo case from the rubric v2 callout. The Melbourne 'ELBOUR' wordmark in the original is replaced with a Red Bull patch on the blue court paint. The composite shows a brighter rectangular zone behind/around the Red Bull mark that does not match the surrounding matte court — the inpaint patch is luminance-mismatched, so the ad reads as a sticker on a slightly lighter rectangle rather than as paint on the court. Color/brightness/saturation of the patch interior are off relative to the original Melbourne paint, hence 3s. Geometry is plausible (perspective and size are within reason). Edge reflex is moderate — not as bad as the side banner. Crucially the floor jitter ratio (0.83) and the noise variance ratio (~26x) flagged regressions in metrics, consistent with a visibly busier patch. Player contact shadow not preserved (no darkening under feet on the painted ad).
